Guide: remote-pair - sibling pairs across two hosts (entwurf-remote-pair.json)

Opt-in, one file per host. Each route pairs a garden id here with one on
another host, so entwurf_v2 to the remote id makes one SSH attempt over your
own account. There is no discovery, wake or retry, and Entwurf sets up no
SSH, key or network.

Where it lives (the rule; this page reads none of your settings):
  entwurf-remote-pair.json, in the directory that holds the garden record
  store. By default the store is the pi agent dir's meta-sessions, so:
    ~/.pi/agent/entwurf-remote-pair.json
  PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR moves the agent dir and ENTWURF_META_SESSIONS_DIR
  moves the store; the file follows the store. The sending bridge and the
  SSH receive side must resolve the same path.

What it holds:
  version                 2
  routes[]                one object per pair:
    localGardenId         this host's garden id in the pair
    remoteGardenId        the other host's garden id
    ssh                   your existing SSH alias for the other host
    remotePairFile        the absolute path of the other host's own file

Write it with mode 0600, and never over a file you have not inspected. The
other host's file carries the mirror route: the two garden ids swapped, its
own SSH alias for this host, and this file's absolute path. No file means
off; a symlink, a non-regular file or an invalid declaration is refused, not
read as off. Delivery never starts, resumes or wakes a sibling that is off.

Steps, checks and converting an older file: section 2c of
docs/setup-clean-host.md, shipped in this entwurf package.
